Class AbandonedShipCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AbandonedShipCard
public class AbandonedShipCard extends AdventureCard
Represents an adventure card that depicts an abandoned ship scenario. This card determines specific game mechanics when drawn, affecting astronauts, credits, and days lost during gameplay.

    • checkRequirements

      public void checkRequirements()
      Checks if the current player meets the requirements to proceed with the action on the Abandoned Ship adventure card. Specifically, it determines if the player has a sufficient number of crew members (including astronauts, brown aliens, and purple aliens) to land on the ship. If the player has enough crew members, the function updates the game state to allow the player to decide whether to land on the ship. A message is displayed informing the player of their crew count, the potential credits earned, and the option to land. The function also checks for possible effects or connections related to the specified game state. If the player does not have enough crew members, a message is displayed, and the turn is passed to the next player.
      Overrides:
      checkRequirements in class AdventureCard

    • landingOnStationOrShip

      public void landingOnStationOrShip(boolean isLanded) throws IllegalMethodOnThisStateException
      Manages the landing decision on a station or ship and performs corresponding actions depending on the player's choice. If the player decides to land, the state of the game is updated to allow further decision-making. If the player decides not to land, the game advances to the next player's turn.
      Overrides:
      landingOnStationOrShip in class AdventureCard
      Parameters:
      isLanded - a boolean indicating whether the player has chosen to land on the station or ship (true if they choose to land, false otherwise)
      Throws:
      IllegalMethodOnThisStateException - if the method is called in an incorrect state of the game
